MIELE.NAME: Miele
MIELE.DESCRIPTION: Miele@home appliances via the official Miele 3rd party API

TOKEN_URL.NAME: Token URL
TOKEN_URL.DESCRIPTION: OAuth token endpoint. Default: the new Miele login (EU). Accounts from countries not supported there (e.g. CH, UK, US) use https://api.mcs3.miele.com/thirdparty/token while Miele keeps it running

CLIENT_ID.NAME: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.DESCRIPTION: Client ID from the Miele developer portal (developer.miele.com)

CLIENT_SECRET.NAME: Client secret
CLIENT_SECRET.DESCRIPTION: Client secret from the Miele developer portal

REFRESH_TOKEN.NAME: Refresh token
REFRESH_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: OAuth refresh token of your Miele account (authorization code login, see README). Miele replaces it on every refresh, the driver keeps the newest one

LANGUAGE.NAME: Language
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Language of program and phase names (e.g. en, de)

POLL.NAME: Full read interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: Changes arrive live through the event stream, this is only a fallback

SCAN.NAME: Search appliances
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the appliances shared with the application

LOGIN_STATUS.NAME: Login status
LOGIN_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: OK or why the login failed

DEVICE_ID.NAME: Device ID
DEVICE_ID.DESCRIPTION: Fabrication number, filled by the scan

STATUS_CODE.NAME: Status code
STATUS_CODE.DESCRIPTION: 1 off, 2 on, 3 programmed, 4 waiting to start, 5 running, 6 pause, 7 end programmed, 8 failure, ..., 255 not connected

STATUS.NAME: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Off, On, Programmed, WaitingToStart, Running, Pause, EndProgrammed, Failure, ...

POWER.NAME: Power
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Write true to switch on and false to switch off (if the appliance allows it right now)

RUNNING.NAME: Running
RUNNING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start and false to stop the program (needs MobileStart or remote control on the appliance)

PAUSED.NAME: Paused
PAUSED.DESCRIPTION: Write true to pause and false to continue

PROGRAM_ID.NAME: Program ID
PROGRAM_ID.DESCRIPTION: Write a program id to start that program

START_TIME.NAME: Start in [min]
START_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Delayed start; write minutes to set it

SIGNAL_INFO.NAME: Info signal
SIGNAL_INFO.DESCRIPTION: The appliance shows a notification (e.g. salt or rinse aid)

LIGHT.NAME: Light
LIGHT.DESCRIPTION: Write true / false to switch the light

SUPERFREEZING.NAME: SuperFrost
SUPERFREEZING.DESCRIPTION: Write true / false to start or stop

SUPERCOOLING.NAME: SuperCool
SUPERCOOLING.DESCRIPTION: Write true / false to start or stop
